Status: Accepted — implemented through Phase 6 Date: 2026-07-31

Context

The demo's in-process limiting is not consistent when API replicas scale out. Authentication, saves, public comments, reports, profile mutation, deletion, and expensive paper operations require enforcement that is shared by every API instance. Introducing Redis or another network service for this milestone would violate the modular-monolith operational boundary without a demonstrated need.

Decision

Use PostgreSQL-backed shared rate-limit buckets, implemented as atomic INSERT ... ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE operations for fixed or sliding windows. PostgreSQL remains the source of truth alongside the existing leased jobs and synchronization records. Apply edge reverse-proxy limits as an additional coarse abuse control, not as the sole application limit. Return the stable RATE_LIMITED error and Retry-After.

Initial buckets cover comment creation (user and keyed request origin), comment edits, reports (user, target, and keyed request origin), profile updates, library mutations, account deletion, and anonymous preparation/chat. The public preparation/chat limiter always consumes a keyed origin bucket and may also consume an anonymous-session bucket; it never relies only on the client-supplied session ID.

Implementation status

Phase 3 adds the shared PostgreSQL bucket table, atomic fixed-window repository, bounded cleanup operation, and the first profile_update per-user bucket. A denied profile update maps to the stable RATE_LIMITED error and a delta-seconds Retry-After value. Phases 4–6 extend that foundation to library, comments/reports, account deletion, and preparation/chat. Public-operation and comment origin scopes use the shared trusted-proxy boundary and one generic, owner-only HMAC key; database failures fail these protected actions closed.

Consequences

  • Rate-limit state is coherent across replicas and can be inspected, expired, tested, and backed up with the product database.
  • New tables/indexes, a cleanup job, transactional integration, and metrics are required; traffic/load tests must validate contention and failure behavior.
  • Limits become configuration with documented defaults and reviewed product policy rather than implicit per-process behavior.
  • Redis, Kafka, NATS, and a separate rate-limit service are out of scope unless a future ADR changes this decision.

Security and operational implications

  • IP/device scope keys are hashed with a rotating server secret when retained; raw identifiers are not logged or unnecessarily persisted.
  • Buckets must have bounded retention and expiration cleanup to avoid unbounded growth. Monitor cleanup failures, denied-action rates, database contention, and bypass attempts.
  • Database outage behavior must fail safely for sensitive writes and remain explicit in service health/runbooks; edge controls provide only supplemental protection.
  • Limits are not authorization. Every protected operation still verifies the authenticated principal and applies ownership/status/terms checks.
htmlZh:
状态： 已接受——已实现至 Phase 6 日期： 2026-07-31

背景

当 API 副本横向扩展时，演示版采用的进程内限流无法保证一致性。认证、保存、 公开评论、举报、个人资料变更操作、删除和高成本论文操作，都需要由每个 API 实例 共同执行同一套限制。在没有明确需求的情况下，为这一里程碑引入 Redis 或其他 网络服务，会违反模块化单体的运营边界。

决策

采用由 PostgreSQL 支持的共享限流桶，通过原子的 INSERT ... ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE 操作实现固定窗口或滑动窗口。 PostgreSQL 与现有的租约作业和同步记录一样，继续作为事实来源。 边缘反向代理的限制只作为额外的粗粒度滥用防护，不能成为唯一的应用级限制。 达到限制时返回稳定错误 RATE_LIMITED 和 Retry-After。

首批限流桶覆盖评论创建（按用户及带密钥的请求来源）、评论编辑、举报 （按用户、目标及带密钥的请求来源）、个人资料更新、Library 变更操作、账户删除， 以及匿名准备/聊天。公开准备/聊天限流器始终会消耗一个带密钥的来源桶， 并且还可能消耗匿名会话桶；它绝不会只依赖客户端提供的会话 ID。

实现状态

Phase 3 增加了共享 PostgreSQL 限流桶表、原子固定窗口存储库、 有界清理操作，以及首个按用户计算的 profile_update 限流桶。 被拒绝的个人资料更新映射为稳定错误 RATE_LIMITED，并返回以秒为单位的差值作为 Retry-After。Phase 4–6 将这一基础能力扩展到 Library、评论/举报、账户删除 以及准备/聊天。公开操作与评论的来源范围共同使用受信任代理边界，以及一把通用、 仅所有者可读的 HMAC 密钥；数据库故障时，默认拒绝这些受保护操作。

后果

  • 限流状态在所有副本之间保持一致，可随产品数据库一同检查、过期、测试和备份。
  • 需要新增数据表及索引、清理作业、事务集成和指标；流量及负载测试必须验证争用和故障行为。
  • 限制值成为带有文档化默认值并经产品政策审核的配置，而不再是隐含的单进程行为。
  • Redis、Kafka、NATS 和独立限流服务均不在范围内，除非未来的 ADR 修改本决策。

安全与运营影响

  • 需要保留 IP/设备范围键时，使用可轮换的服务端密钥对其进行哈希；原始标识符不得写入日志，也不得无必要地持久化。
  • 限流桶必须具有有界保留期，并清理过期数据，以免无限增长。应监控清理失败、被拒操作比例、数据库争用和绕过尝试。
  • 数据库中断时，敏感写入必须安全地默认拒绝；这一行为也必须在服务健康检查和运行手册中明确说明。边缘控制只能提供补充保护。
  • 限流不等于授权。每个受保护操作仍须验证已认证主体，并执行所有权、状态和条款检查。
